# Session plan (generated by `python -m slwlab.sessions`, do not edit)

> **PLANNING**, not measurement. Leader schedules are SNAPSHOT data; power is SIMULATION (`alloc_v1.json` curves, N = 6, half-strength / exact rule). Validators from `selection_20261022T163227Z.json`.

Schedule proxy: epochs 1065, 1066 (50.86 h at 211.901 ms/slot). Assumptions: calibration + prereg freeze take the first 2 h of session 1; 15% of windows are lost to gaps/late/stalls (to be replaced by the measured fraction); usable rate 0.886; windows ≥ 5 s apart; seed 20261022.

**Notes:**

- BamFiredancer: quota in the allocation but no validator in `selection_20261022T163227Z.json` (51 windows per validator cannot be filled)

## 1. Hours needed per validator and per cell

Windows/h = the validator's leader windows in the saved epochs / their duration. Validator hours = all its cells' quotas / windows per hour; cell hours = that cell's quota alone. Arms share one validator's windows, so a validator needs the validator hours, not its largest cell. No gaps or spacing conflicts here (see the scenarios).
